name: Augustus Minerals Limited
summary: Augustus Minerals Limited explores and develops mineral projects in Western Australia, looking for copper, gold, nickel, platinum group metals, molybdenum, rhenium, lithium and rare earth elements. It holds interests in the Ti Tree Shear project in the Gascoyne Province and the Music Well Gold project in the Leonora/Laverton Greenstone Belt. It was incorporated in 2021 and has its base in West Perth.
